mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite adapted noncommuting martingale trace moments and maximal inequalities; protected-mark prefix law at first exit; exact endpoint normalization and scaled drift algebra for rational unitary feedback.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z, Q and Q(i), exact Fraction arithmetic.
mathematics.conventions: Unnormalized Schatten moments; even powers; predictably shrinking coordinate support; full first crossing retained; frozen scalar endpoint increments set to zero before port averaging.
inputs: Sixteen adapted symmetric-matrix martingale paths, support 4,3,2,1, even powers 4..12.
All marked deletion prefixes N=3..7 and terminal depth 2..N, with nontrivial path-dependent first-exit predicates.
Walsh Hadamard U(16), all 16 deletion ports and four rational circle phases, row and diagonal/offdiagonal pair normalization.
non_claims: No proof certificate of dimension-uniform asymptotics.
Prescribed phases are not Haar quadrature and do not reverify the prior one-step continuous phase integrals.
No fixed-u, eigenvector-intensity or BGS theorem.
